test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are marked with the letters U to Z. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite the face showing 'W'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a41ab87f1e77caff8d4a3eb4d0a730ecab3d2fb0e3d3c43b217507d5618a6aec.png]
solution:
In first and second dice V and X are common in both dices.

First dice is rotated 900 clockwise vertically on the other adjacent side of V and X is 'Y'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a02151a2631f74bc313d58415727f4edc2ba0a555f23d631487256675641f985.png] 

∴ Here, the opposite face of 'W' is 'Y'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Y".**
